nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: Wind, heather and a grey sky. Far off, the Manalith hangs over the moor, bigger than the Moorfolk say it used to be.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: Tithe is down this road. Half a day if the weather holds.

nodes.speaker: class-barbarian
nodes.line: Something's moving in the heather. Wolves. Stay close to the cart.
